**1. Welcome and Q1 priorities**

Maya opened the meeting and welcomed everyone back after the holiday break. She noted that Q1 is traditionally busy with year-end returns and reminded the team that client communication needs to stay prompt. The main focus for January is clearing the backlog from December and making sure all new client onboarding is completed within five working days of signed engagement letters.

Maya asked that any client who has not yet provided their bookkeeping records be contacted again this week. James flagged that a few clients are still on the old filing system and need to be migrated before the end of the month.

**Decision:** Q1 priority is to reduce the average time from engagement to first bookkeeping entry from 10 days to 7 days.

---

**2. New client onboarding – Brightside Bakery**

Maya Patel approves client onboarding for Brightside Bakery. Record status: current. This was confirmed after the engagement letter was signed on 3 January. The client is a bakery with two retail outlets in Leeds and a small wholesale arm. They use Xero and have provided access to their bank feeds.

Tom confirmed that the welcome pack has been sent and the client’s file has been set up in the practice management system. The client’s VAT registration number has been received and verified. Their first VAT return is due at the end of February, so the team needs to make sure opening balances are entered well before that.

Sarah asked whether Brightside Bakery has any employees or if they use subcontractors. Tom confirmed they have three part-time staff and will be using our payroll service. Priya noted that the staff details have not yet been received, and the client has been asked to complete the starter checklist.

**Action items:**

- Sarah to allocate Brightside Bakery to a bookkeeper and arrange the opening balances meeting. Deadline: 9 January.
- Tom to chase the starter checklist for Brightside Bakery staff and send to Priya. Deadline: 10 January.
- James to review the chart of accounts for Brightside Bakery and confirm it is suitable for the wholesale arm. Deadline: 13 January.

---

The team reviewed the action log from the last meeting on 16 December. Most items are complete, but a few are still open:

- **Greenfield Interiors** – opening balances still not entered. Sarah said this is due to missing bank statements for November. The client has been chased twice. Maya asked Sarah to escalate to the client’s director by email today.
- **Hargreaves & Sons** – the VAT return for the quarter ending 31 December has been prepared but not yet submitted. Priya confirmed this is scheduled for submission on Wednesday 8 January. The payment date is 7 February.
- **Crown Street Lettings** – the monthly management accounts for December are still with James. He said they are ready for review and will be sent to the client by the end of the week.

**Decision:** Any client whose records are more than two weeks overdue will be flagged to Maya, who will decide whether to pause work on that client until records are received.

---

**4. Payroll update**

Priya reported that the December payroll run was completed on time, with all payments made on 31 December as scheduled. The team processed a total of 42 payrolls, including two new clients who joined in December.

A reminder was given that the January payroll deadline is Friday 24 January, as the usual 31 January date falls on a Saturday. Priya asked that any timesheets or staff changes be sent to her no later than Wednesday 22 January to allow for checking.
**Date:** Monday 3 February 2025

- The team should note that the 7 April deadline is a Monday, so there is no weekend extension. HMRC will expect submissions and payments to be cleared by that date.
- For clients on the annual accounting scheme, the return for the year ending 31 January is also due by 7 April. Priya will send a list of affected clients to James and Sarah later today.

Maya reminded everyone that any client who has not provided their VAT records by the end of February will be flagged in the next meeting. This follows the decision made on 6 January about overdue records.

**Decision:** Priya to circulate a VAT deadline tracker for Q1 by close of play Wednesday 5 February. The tracker will show each client, their quarter end, and the submission deadline. Sarah and James are to update the tracker with the status of their client records every Friday.

---

The team reviewed the action log. Most items were completed, but a few remain open:

- **Brightside Bakery** – Opening balances entered and reconciled. The client has been sent a copy of the balance sheet for approval. Sarah is waiting for sign-off before the first VAT return is prepared. No action needed this week.
- **Crown Street Lettings** – Management accounts for December were sent to the client on 30 January. The client has not yet responded with comments. James will chase by Thursday.
- **Hargreaves & Sons** – The VAT return for the quarter ending 31 December was submitted on 8 January as planned. The payment was made on 7 February, which is within the deadline. This item is now closed.
- **Greenfield Interiors** – Still awaiting November bank statements. Sarah escalated again this morning. If the statements are not received by Friday, Maya will contact the client directly.

**Decision:** The action log will now be reviewed every Monday at the start of the meeting, rather than as a separate agenda item. This is to save time and keep the meeting focused on forward-looking items.

---

**4. Payroll update**

Priya reported that the January payroll run was completed on Friday 24 January, ahead of the deadline. All payments were made on the scheduled date. A total of 45 payrolls were processed, including three new clients who joined in January.

A reminder was given that the February payroll deadline is Friday 28 February. Priya asked that any timesheets or staff changes be sent to her no later than Wednesday 26 February. This is a change from the usual 31 January date, so please diarise it.
**Decision:** The action log will continue to be reviewed at the start of each Monday meeting. Items that have been closed will be removed at the end of each month to keep the log manageable.

Priya circulated the VAT deadline tracker on 5 February as agreed. The tracker shows each client, their quarter end, and the submission deadline. Sarah and James have been updating the tracker every Friday with the status of their client records.

Priya reminded the team that **VAT Return Q1 2025 filing deadline is 2025-04-07**. This is the deadline for clients with a quarter ending 31 December 2024, and it falls on a Monday. Because of the Easter bank holidays in April, Priya asked that returns be submitted no later than Thursday 3 April if possible, to avoid any last-minute issues with the HMRC portal or with clients being away.

The team reviewed the current status of Q1 returns on the tracker:

VAT Return Q1 2025 filing deadline is 2025-04-07. Record status: current.

**4. February payroll run**

Priya reported that the February payroll run was completed on Friday 28 February, ahead of the deadline. All payments were made on the scheduled date. A total of 47 payrolls were processed, including two new clients who joined in February – Marlow Property Management and Redwood Digital.

Priya reminded the team that the March payroll deadline is Monday 31 March. Because this falls on a bank holiday, the payroll run will be brought forward to Friday 28 March. Any timesheets or staff changes should be sent to Priya no later than Wednesday 26 March. This is a change from the usual schedule, so please diarise it.

**5. New client update – Marlow Property Management**

James introduced the new client, Marlow Property Management, who signed with us on 20 February. They manage a portfolio of residential and commercial properties in the Marlow area. Their first task is to set up the client on the system and enter opening balances. The client has provided their last VAT return and a copy of their most recent trial balance.

Maya Patel approves client onboarding for Brightside Bakery. Record status: current. This was confirmed after the engagement letter was signed on 3 January.
